recap_documents.description: Magistrate Judge Donald L. Cabell: ELECTRONIC ORDER entered finding as moot 8 Motion for Extension of Time. Plaintiff seeks to extend the time to serve summons to defendant Scott Roby (Roby). (D. 8). The motion (D. 8) is MOOT in light of the subsequent filing of an amended complaint (D. 9) as of course under Fed. R. Civ. P. 15(a)(1). See Connectu LLC v. Zuckerberg, 522 F.3d 82, 91 (1st Cir. 2008) (amended complaint, once filed, normally supersedes prior complaint, which is dead letter and no longer performs any function in the case) (internal quotation marks and citations omitted)); accord In re Jackson, 988 F.3d 583, 592 (1st Cir. 2021) (quoting Connectu, 522 F.3d at 91). Plaintiff is advised that he has 90 days after the May 4, 2022 filing of the amended complaint to serve defendants, including Roby. See Fed. R. Civ. P. 4(m); Fed. R. Civ. P. 5(a)(1)(B). (Russo, Noreen) (Entered: 05/12/2022)
